answer: Re-attestations are stored in beacon and gale lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the ocean graph. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 4 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1122 impostors cost 807 times the honest price and take 13 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
